Build the Rust core and set `INNOVATE_NATIVE_LIBRARY` to its absolute shared-library
path. This development package exposes bounded native scientific paths; full
migration, calibrated uncertainty and native distribution qualification remain open.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
library(innovate.R)
kernel_predict_model("logistic", list(inputs=list(time=c(0,1,2)),
    parameters=list(L=100,k=1,x0=1)))
```

Requests use schema 2.0. Computation and validation occur in Rust. The binding
copies JSON response text and releases each native allocation exactly once.
